name: LSASS Process Reconnaissance Via Findstr.EXE
description: Detects findstring commands that include the keyword lsass, which indicates recon actviity for the LSASS process PID
author: GAI_CTI
query: (((process.executable:(*\\find.exe OR *\\findstr.exe)) OR (process.pe.original_file_name:(FIND.EXE OR FINDSTR.EXE))) AND process.command_line:*lsass*) OR (process.command_line:(*\ \-i\ \"lsass* OR *\ \/i\ \"lsass* OR *\ –i\ \"lsass* OR *\ —i\ \"lsass* OR *\ ―i\ \"lsass*) OR process.command_line:(*\ \-i\ lsass.exe* OR *\ \/i\ lsass.exe* OR *\ –i\ lsass.exe* OR *\ —i\ lsass.exe* OR *\ ―i\ lsass.exe*) OR process.command_line:(*findstr\ \"lsass*) OR process.command_line:(*findstr\ lsass*) OR process.command_line:(*findstr.exe\ \"lsass*) OR process.command_line:(*findstr.exe\ lsass*))
